title: Bounded transcript queries and pagination
database: local PostgreSQL ephemeral database managed by PostgresTestDatabaseLease

commands.result: expected red: per-item definition/conversation reads and in-memory transcript Skip(offset) were reachable

commands.command: git diff --check and current-source bounded-read guards

sourceAssertions: Definition, conversation, operation, and transcript queries use explicit read-store contracts over canonical tables.
Definition and conversation collection reads have no per-item repository lookup loop.
Transcript pages use sequence keysets and SQL Take(pageSize + 1), never document materialization followed by Skip/Take.
Production turn admission, resume, completion, and compensation use ILlmConversationTurnStore; the EF implementation reads only system entries and the newest bounded non-system range.
Externally accepted cursors are kind-specific typed values with deterministic ordering and enforced page limits.
No production partial expansion, project-reference cycle, or forbidden Web/provider dependency was introduced.
behavioralCases: 24 definitions page deterministically across two keyset pages with two SQL commands per page and no duplicates
conversation collection projection executes one SQL command
a 2,000-message canonical transcript returns a 25-entry ordered page with two SQL commands
resuming the active turn builds exactly 12 provider-context messages using three bounded SQL commands
bounded context preserves the system instruction first and exact pending user entry last
all public page requests enforce typed cursors and configured maximum sizes
negativeCases: pre-SB05 definition and conversation list code performs per-item reads
pre-SB05 transcript paging materializes a document then applies Skip(offset)
invalid or cross-kind cursor payloads are rejected instead of silently restarting a page
operation invocation detail overflow fails predictably instead of silently truncating evidence
full-document EF load is unreachable from the production per-turn provider-context path

acceptance.criterion: Transcript paging executes a bounded SQL query and never materializes the full transcript.
acceptance.evidence: The 2,000-message PostgreSQL test returns 25 entries with two commands; EfLlmChatConversationReadStore applies sequence keyset and Take(pageSize + 1).

acceptance.criterion: Conversation and definition listings do not issue one query per item.
acceptance.evidence: The PostgreSQL command interceptor observes one conversation-list command and two definition-list commands regardless of page item count.

acceptance.criterion: Context-window construction reads only the bounded entries it can send.
acceptance.evidence: EfLlmConversationTurnStore loads state plus bounded system/newest ranges; the 2,000-message resume returns exactly the configured 12 messages in three SQL commands.

acceptance.criterion: Externally exposed collections use deterministic cursors and enforced page limits.
acceptance.evidence: Definition and conversation cursors carry updated-at plus stable id; transcript cursor carries canonical sequence; kind-specific Web decoding and application page-size validation reject invalid input.

acceptance.criterion: Large-transcript tests prove stable memory/query behavior without changing canonical content.
acceptance.evidence: The direct PostgreSQL test seeds 2,000 canonical entries, observes fixed command counts and bounded result sizes, and the read/resume paths report the unchanged persisted entry count of 2,000.

architecture.owner: application read-store contracts define projections; EF read stores own bounded SQL; ILlmConversationTurnStore owns bounded turn persistence/context; Web owns opaque cursor transport only
architecture.dependencyDirection: MAF/application contracts -> EF read/turn adapters -> Web/composition mapping; no reverse product dependency
architecture.cycleCheck: CodeAnalytics snap-20260815034954-c4aa2a0f: four scoped projects, zero cycles, zero diagnostics, no error findings
architecture.oldPathRemoval: command repositories no longer expose collection reads; application lists have no per-item lookup; transcript and turn paths no longer load a full EF conversation document

bugs: Completion snapshots now always reserve capacity for the newest non-system entry so the just-persisted assistant result remains available even when system entries fill the configured context window.
Turn compensation treats NotFound as already terminal, preserving idempotent deletion behavior.
Cursor endpoint mapping was corrected so definition and conversation routes decode only their own cursor kinds.
deviations: Six focused test attempts were needed, exceeding the four-command budget: the first Unit run exposed two lifecycle assertions, and Integration attempts exposed one test compile error, one EF translation error, and one fixture fingerprint mismatch before the final passes. Each rerun followed a concrete code or fixture correction; no unfiltered or solution-wide test was run.

Three affected build commands were used: one Web compile failed on nullable cursor inference, followed by successful Persistence and Integration builds. No additional build was run after the final local capacity-reservation source correction because the budget was exhausted; the edit is expression-only and source/architecture guards passed.
No schema/model change was introduced, so SB05 did not spend an EF pending-model command.
knownGaps: CP1 still must re-evaluate the complete SB01-SB05 backend invariant chain.
Streaming event retention and replay query bounds remain owned by SB08-SB11.

progression.reason: All SB05 bounded read, deterministic cursor, large-transcript, historical negative, source-removal, PostgreSQL command-count, and architecture evidence passes at implementation commit e88987c2018adcf9118d49109eb8d4e3d3eb2c12; the recorded command-budget deviation did not broaden test scope or leave a semantic failure.
